description: Estonia's average and MEDIAN monthly gross wage in ONE call, from Statistics Estonia (Statistikaamet, table PA111), keyless, with the recent quarterly trend. PREFER for "what is the average wage in Estonia", "Estonian salary", "average monthly wage in Estonia according to official statistics", "are Estonian wages rising". GROSS (before income tax and the employee's share of contributions) and per EMPLOYEE POSITION, so somebody holding two jobs is counted twice. Use subjects/table_meta/query_table for breakdowns by economic activity or county.

quarters.description: How many recent quarters to include (1-40, default 8). Headline fields describe the newest.
